description: This file defines an abstract base class for Voice Activity Detection (VAD) analysis, including related data structures, states, and utility methods for audio stream analysis in a speech processing system.

classes.name: VADState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible voice activity detection states: QUIET, STARTING, SPEAKING, STOPPING.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for VAD, including confidence threshold, start/stop durations, and minimum volume.

classes.name: VADAnalyzer
classes.description: Abstract base class providing framework for VAD analysis, including state management, parameter setting, and audio buffer processing.

methods.name: num_frames_required
methods.description: Abstract method to specify number of audio frames needed for analysis.

methods.name: voice_confidence
methods.description: Abstract method to compute voice activity confidence score from audio buffer.

methods.name: set_sample_rate
methods.description: Set the sample rate for audio processing and recalculate internal parameters.

methods.name: set_params
methods.description: Update VAD parameters and recalculate related internal values.

methods.name: _get_smoothed_volume
methods.description: Calculate smoothed audio volume using exponential smoothing.

methods.name: analyze_audio
methods.description: Asynchronously analyze audio buffer and determine current VAD state.

methods.name: _run_analyzer
methods.description: Process audio buffer to update VAD state based on confidence and volume thresholds.
